Cloud Q1 financials & margin

live-01: 数值正确；首步文档检索失败，后续改用纯取数计划。
Values correct; initial document search failed, then the plan switched to numeric retrieval.
live-02: 此用例数值与来源核验通过。
Values and sources verified for this case.

live-01: 金额与三项限定已取得；仍有过度查询和缺口归属问题，未通过全面验收。
Amount and all three conditions retrieved; over-querying and gap attribution remain unresolved.
live-02: 重复指引保留各自披露，不相加。金额与限定正确，仍保留无关检索缺口。
Repeated guidance retains each disclosure; do not sum. Amount and conditions are correct, but incidental gaps remain.

live-01: 验收未通过：模型擅自选择了三年的期间。下方保留当时的错误运行结果。
Acceptance failed: the model chose three years without authorization. The original incorrect run is preserved below.
live-02: 已要求澄清且未取数；原回复对连续季度覆盖和 YTD 能力的描述不准确。
Clarified without fetching data; original prose overstates continuous quarterly coverage and YTD support.

review_notes: 存档层保留原始 HTML/PDF；文档索引保留文本块、表格单元格及定位。尚未证明视觉布局与所有图片内容被完整转换为可查询字段。
Original HTML/PDF files are retained; indexes preserve text blocks, table cells and locators. Complete conversion of layout and image content into queryable fields has not been established.
抽取层只覆盖选定的指标和电话会片段。37 行不代表全文已经结构化；未抽取的信息仍需回读原文。
Extraction covers selected metrics and call passages. The 37 rows are not full-document coverage; unextracted information still requires source reading.
金额按尺度转换为 USD，原尺度、原始值和 XBRL 维度保存在证据及 origin。数据库使用 DECIMAL；超出支持精度会拒绝，不静默舍入。
Amounts are normalized to USD; original scale, values and XBRL dimensions remain in evidence and origin. Database DECIMAL limits reject unsupported precision rather than silently rounding.
“略高于一半”被结构化为 > 50%，但“略高于”的接近程度没有单独数值字段；完整措辞仍在原文证据中。只读 value=50 会误解结果。
“Just over half” becomes > 50%, but its closeness to half is not separately quantified. Exact wording remains in evidence; reading only value=50 would misrepresent it.
公开时间目前只有日期，没有盘中时间精度。电话会定性规范化依赖已审阅的特定来源适配器，不能直接推广到任意公司。
Availability is date-level, not intraday. Qualitative call normalization uses a reviewed source-specific adapter, not a general solution for every company.

cloud_ml_compute_share: 50 是阈值，关系 gt 表示“大于”；分母是 ML 算力，不是总 CapEx。expected 保留预期语气。
50 is a threshold and gt means greater than. The denominator is ML compute, not total CapEx; expected preserves forecast modality.
“just over”的接近程度仍仅保留在原话，SQL 数值字段无法单独表达。
The closeness expressed by “just over” remains only in the quote, not a numeric SQL field.
building_useful_life: 40 years or longer 被表示为 ≥40；could 保留可能性，不是所有设备的保证寿命。
40 years or longer is represented as ≥40; could retains possibility, not a guaranteed life for every asset.
investment_mix_outlook: 同一段原话拆出 FY2026 定性展望；不把 FY2025 的约 60/40 比例复制成 FY2026 的精确预测。
A separate FY2026 qualitative outlook is split from the source; the FY2025 approximate 60/40 mix is not copied into an exact FY2026 forecast.
capex_guidance: 175–185 十亿美元转换为 USD 基础单位，两个边界保留；不同发言人的重复披露保留，不相加。
175–185 billion is converted to base USD with both bounds retained. Repeated speakers’ disclosures remain separate and are not summed.
revenue: 原财务值不变；报告分部维度被映射为查询口径，原 XBRL 维度仍保留在 origin。
The financial value is retained; segment dimensions are mapped for querying, while original XBRL dimensions remain in origin.
operating_income: 原财务值不变；分部与合并分组轴的原始表达留在 origin，查询只使用已声明的维度映射。
The financial value is retained; original segment/consolidation axes remain in origin, with only declared mappings used for queries.

update_notes: 获取并冻结新材料及其版本：保留原文、来源身份、公开日期和内容指纹。当前由脚本或人工触发，没有自动监控新披露。
Acquire and freeze new source versions with identity, availability date and content hash. Scripts or people trigger this today; disclosure monitoring is not automatic.
为新材料生成索引和候选抽取结果。已有适配器范围外的公司、财年或措辞需要新增映射和验证；模型抽取可能产生费用。
Build indexes and candidate extractions. New companies, fiscal calendars or unsupported language require mappings and validation; model extraction may incur cost.
准备显式构建配置：列出要保留的历史输入和新增输入，以及各自来源、适配器与 hash。构建器不会自动合并旧数据库。
Prepare an explicit build spec listing retained historical inputs and new inputs, with source, adapter and hash bindings. The builder does not automatically merge an old database.
build_dataset 在新目录重建 DuckDB 和证据包，校验成功后发布该目录；已有目标目录拒绝覆盖。输入或适配器变化会形成新 snapshot_id。
build_dataset rebuilds DuckDB and evidence in a new directory, publishing it after validation. Existing destinations cannot be overwritten; changed inputs/adapters produce a new snapshot_id.
核对新增、修订、重复和冲突，再显式选择新快照供查询或登记到展示配置。同值重复披露保留来源；冲突值阻止计算，不默认取最新。

Review additions, revisions, duplicates and conflicts, then explicitly select/register the new snapshot. Equivalent disclosures keep their sources; conflicting values block calculation instead of defaulting to the latest.
